privileged_info_for_vlm: The framework requires three grades: 'Grade A - Senior' (USD 90,000-140,000), 'Grade B - Mid-Level' (USD 60,000-90,000), and 'Grade C - Junior' (USD 40,000-60,000). Employee James Anderson (EMP001) must be assigned to 'Grade A - Senior'. The agent must use the OrangeHRM web UI to perform these configurations.
